actions.action: Cease and desist order and civil money penalty ($350M)
actions.summary: BSA program deficiencies: weak risk assessment of the card business, ineffective customer due diligence and risk rating, inconsistent customer identification, untimely or missed SARs, weak independent testing and staffing. OCC tied the gaps to roughly $13B in suspected trade-based money laundering (2014–2025). A parallel Federal Reserve consent order adds transaction monitoring, fraud-referral, third-party risk and OFAC remediation.
actions.opener: Orders like this usually come with an end-to-end program review on a deadline. How are you handling first-pass alert review while that's underway?
